question: Where can I find the nearest museum to the northeast of Mentor Civic Arena, Mentor, OH?
sql: SELECT poi_name, addr_city, addr_state FROM pois WHERE museum IS TRUE AND degrees(ST_Azimuth( ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Mentor Civic Arena%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Mentor%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%OH%' LIMIT 1 ), geometry )) BETWEEN 22.5 AND 67.5 ORDER BY ST_Distance( geometry, ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Mentor Civic Arena%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Mentor%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%OH%' LIMIT 1 )::geography ) LIMIT 1;
